added_cases.f01: frozen IF09 candidate pixels with unchanged independent nomination rules
added_cases.fresh: new locally found source, 2 fps frozen candidate pool, 30 s analysis windows

reference_contract: Exact verified points or source spans, separate from prediction. Out-of-reference reads are unjudged unless explicitly negative. No absence or identity is inferred.
control: Same unchanged source-bound reader, byte-preserving native PNG item handoff and distinct-image/real-window ceilings. No use of the source evaluation appendix by inference.
weights: Rank channels independently, fuse ranks without duplicate-root votes. Fixed before prediction. Role scheduling is R5-only and uses registrable view evidence, query terms and order constraints, never evaluator ranges.
